name: Perplexity
description: Perplexity describes itself as an AI answer engine that researches the open web in real time and returns concise, cited answers.
best_for: Perplexity positions itself for people who want real-time, cited answers to questions rather than a list of links — i.e., research/search replacement, with Pro tiers for deeper "Pro Search," file uploads, and Spaces (saved research collections).

alternatives.name: ChatGPT
alternatives.description: OpenAI's AI assistant offering chat, voice, vision, and agentic "Work"/"Codex" capabilities.
alternatives.best_for: Users wanting one broad assistant across chat, research, documents, and coding.

alternatives.name: Gemini
alternatives.description: Google DeepMind's family of AI models for building and using intelligent agents across text, image, video, and audio.
alternatives.best_for: Users needing deep research across very large documents/contexts with Search integration.

pricing.starting_price: Standard is free; Pro is $20/month or $200/year

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Free core search with limited Pro Searches and basic file uploads; no access to advanced AI models, image generation, or premium support.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: $20/month or $200/year; adds higher research/search limits, advanced models, file analysis, image generation, and priority support.

tiers.name: Education Pro
tiers.notes: For verified students and educators; eligibility verification required.

tiers.name: Max
tiers.notes: $200/month or $2,000/year on the web app; highest consumer access levels.

cons: The Free plan has very limited Pro Search access and does not include advanced AI models, image generation, or premium support.
API usage is billed separately and is not included with consumer or Enterprise subscriptions.
Max's annual billing option is available through the web app; mobile upgrades can create a separate subscription from an existing web subscription.
